posts.name: Usman Ali Khan
posts.cooked:
I really like the new ERpnext UI design changes. However i have 2 questions:

  1. is is possible to by-pass the apps Icon page (of Accounts, Selling, Buying) and directly land to some home page inside the app like before? if so, how please.
  2. in the new UI each category like Accounts, HR, Selling, Buying have their own icon on desktop to access but inside u can’t select to switch from one to another. e.g. from Selling to Buying. You have to go to desk and then re-enter or use search function. for someone who is new to system s/he might not know exactly to search from therefore would suggest to have some drop down in the sidebar where desk and website are given (or somewhere else as UI dictates) to quickly switch rather than going back to desk and then selecting another area.
